ov: Fifteen species of fast, streamlined ocean predators in the mackerel family. With the opah and mackerel sharks, tuna are the only fish that keep their bodies warmer than the water around them. The first fin on the back folds flat into a groove.

why.et: Fished extensively for food, and some species are threatened by overfishing.

fx: The yellowfin tuna can swim at up to 75 km/h.
In Japan, tuna as a food can be called “sea chicken” (shī chikin).
